Technology partners Stronger outcomes through the right ecosystem.

We work with selected technology vendors, service providers and strategic partners to design around customer outcomes — not product quotas.

Technology partners
Two, deliberately. This page grows slowly.
Network as a service
Sovereign infrastructure

Connectivity without an import licence

Extending a network into a new market usually means shipping appliances, clearing customs and waiting. Graphiant delivers the transport as a service, so opening a country becomes a configuration decision rather than a logistics one.

Together

We design the topology, the residency model and the policy that governs it. Graphiant carries the traffic.

Where it fits

Cross-border enterprise connectivity · operator B2B services · markets where hardware import is the binding constraint.

Featured solution →
Managed detection and response
AI-powered cybersecurity

Detection you can show your regulator

Most managed detection tells you an alert fired. Expel shows how the judgement was reached — which is the part a regulated security team is actually required to evidence.

Together

We own onboarding, tuning and the relationship with the estate. Expel provides the detection and response platform behind it.

Where it fits

Enterprises without a 24/7 security operations capability, and teams that have to show their working to an auditor.

Featured solution →

Logos are each partner's own, used in the form their brand guidelines permit.
